title: About Me
firstParagraph: I'm a full-stack software engineer with 8+ years of building SaaS products in property-tech, health-tech, fintech and e-commerce. I own systems end-to-end: architecture, backend, frontend, infrastructure-as-code and the AI layer on top.
secondParagraph: Teams bring me the hard problems: high-load data pipelines on ClickHouse, low-latency request handling with Nginx and Lua, complex third-party integrations (Airbnb, VRBO, Google, payment providers) and LLM features that actually reach users, such as RAG assistants, real-time translation and ChatGPT-driven automation. My core stack is PHP/Laravel and Go on the server, Vue and React on the client, PostgreSQL underneath and AWS around it.
backendDevBody: PHP / Laravel, Go and Node.js services: APIs, third-party integrations and background jobs, shipped with Docker and CI/CD on AWS.
frontendDevBody: Interactive Vue / Nuxt and React / Next.js applications with a responsive, maintainable UI.
aiIntegrationBody: LLM-powered features: RAG assistants over large knowledge bases, automated replies, real-time translation and agents with tool calling.
databaseArchitectureBody: PostgreSQL, MySQL and ClickHouse: schema design, SQL optimization and real-time analytics for high-traffic systems.
